WITH eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034
    FROM drivers d
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND d.XCL_040 BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM results r
          JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
          WHERE r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
            AND ra.XCL_066 >= 2010
            AND r.XCL_082 > 0
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM results r
          JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
          WHERE r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
            AND ra.XCL_066 >= 2010
            AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
      )
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        r.XCL_088 AS fastest_lap_time,
        (CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + 
        (CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, '.') - INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + 
        (CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    JOIN eligible_drivers ed ON r.XCL_075 = ed.XCL_034
    WHERE ra.XCL_066 >= 2010
      AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    d.XCL_040 AS date_of_birth,
    fl.fastest_lap_time
FROM fastest_laps fl
JOIN drivers d ON fl.driver_id = d.XCL_034
ORDER BY fl.time_in_seconds ASC
LIMIT 1
